title: Use the already admitted publisher digest through model transfer and publication
goal: When publisher admission binds an immutable revision and checksum, issue only the intended GET and validate that same checksum before publishing. Preserve unpinned HEAD behavior, unknown files, partial-transfer recovery, ETag/range semantics and privacy checks. Report success only after the publisher receipt is stored. A failed publication or sidecar write must leave the task and its requested URL visibly failed, including when a later caller adopts the same bytes.
